name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since 4 Nov; Kim says the country seeks security, not supremacy
state: North Korea fired multiple missiles on 4 Nov, its fourth weapons launch in a month, according to Seoul (The Star). On 23 Nov state media reported Kim Jong Un receiving foreign ambassadors' credentials and saying the country seeks security, not supremacy, after he did not meet Trump during the APEC trip (CP24/AP). Searches to 24 Nov found no later launch, nuclear test or border clash, so with no launch in the past two weeks the level stays Normal.
for_you: No change to travel advice for South Korea or Japan; check FCDO travel advice. North Korean launches can trigger brief alerts in Japan; follow local authority instructions if one is issued.
rubric_hit: Normal: no missile launch since 4 Nov (over two weeks); no nuclear test or border clash
